_note: Single source of truth for Line of Command V1 balance numbers. spec.md quotes these values; if they disagree, this file wins and spec.md is the bug.
id_policy: ids (dictionary keys and every 'id' value) are stable and never renamed; 'name' is the display string and may change between versions; 'legacy_names' lists earlier display strings so saves, logs and text can be matched. Code must key on ids, never on names.

cannon.name: Gun Section (2 guns)
cannon.display_note: v1.3: 50 men and 2 guns is a historical gun section, not a 4-6 gun battery (historian-assessment.md); numbers unchanged

_strength_note: strength = troops x toughness. Damage is dealt in strength; casualties shown = strength lost / toughness. Morale, elimination and timeout use strength, so a point of any unit type is worth about the same.

targeting._note: weight of each enemy unit type as a target = alive troops x exposure x preference

canister._note: cannon firing at distance <= 1 uses canister
